input.quote: 2.2 Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
input.rationale: Section 2.2 binds Customer to source hosted analytics services solely from Vendor for the whole term. That is an exclusivity/field-of-use restriction on the products and services we may buy or build, which the playbook does not accept (preferred: no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer). It also directly conflicts with Section 2.1 (no purchase commitment) and Section 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment), so the restriction should be removed rather than merely narrowed. No other clause restricts Customer's business; Section 24.2's competitor limit binds Vendor and is acceptable.

ops.oldText: 2.2 Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
ops.newText: 2.2 Vendor's appointment is non-exclusive. Customer may develop, acquire, or procure hosted analytics or any other services from any source, and nothing in this Agreement restricts Customer's business, products, or fields of use.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot grant exclusivity or otherwise restrict the services we may buy or build, so we have made Vendor's appointment non-exclusive; this also removes the conflict with Sections 2.1 and 12.3. If Vendor needs protection, we could consider a narrow, product-specific restriction during the term only (max 12 months) with carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions.
proposal.summary: Convert Section 2.2 exclusivity into a non-exclusive appointment with express confirmation of no restriction on Customer's business.
